description: A command-line package manager for Debian and derivatives.

next.name: autoclean
tip: Clear out only package files that can no longer be downloaded.

next.name: autopurge
tip: Automatically remove unused packages including configuration files.

next.name: autoremove
tip: Automatically remove all unused packages.

next.name: build-dep
tip: Install/remove packages to satisfy build dependencies.

option.name: --arch-only
tip: Only process architecture-dependent build dependencies.

option.name: --build-profiles
tip: Control the activated build profiles for build dependencies.

option.name: --host-architecture
tip: Control the architecture build dependencies are satisfied for.

option.name: --indep-only
tip: Only process architecture-independent build dependencies.

next.name: changelog
tip: Download and display the changelog of a package.

next.name: clean
tip: Clear out the local repository of retrieved package files.

next.name: depends
tip: Show dependency information for a package.

next.name: distclean
tip: Remove all files under /var/lib/apt/lists except release files.

next.name: download
tip: Download binary packages into the current directory.

next.name: edit-sources
tip: Edit the source information file.

next.name: full-upgrade
tip: Upgrade the system by removing/installing/upgrading packages.

next.name: help
tip: Display help information.

next.name: install
tip: Install packages.

next.name: list
tip: List packages based on package names.

option.name: --all-versions
tip: List all available versions.

option.name: --installed
tip: List installed packages only.

option.name: --manual-installed
tip: List manually installed packages only.

option.name: --upgradeable
tip: List upgradeable packages only.

next.name: moo
tip: Have you mooed today?
This APT has Super Cow Powers.

next.name: policy
tip: Show policy settings and priority selection.

next.name: purge
tip: Remove packages including their configuration files.

next.name: rdepends
tip: Show reverse dependency information for a package.

next.name: reinstall
tip: Reinstall packages.
An alias for install --reinstall.

next.name: remove
tip: Remove packages, leaving configuration files behind.

next.name: satisfy
tip: Satisfy dependency strings, as used in Build-Depends.

example.desc: Satisfy dependencies, handling conflicts prefixed with Conflicts:

next.name: search
tip: Search in package descriptions.

option.name: --full
tip: Show full package records for each match.

option.name: --names-only
tip: Search package names only, not descriptions.

next.name: show
tip: Show package details.

option.name: --all-versions
tip: Show records for all available versions.

next.name: showsrc
tip: Show source package records.

next.name: source
tip: Fetch source packages into the current directory.

option.name: --build-profiles
tip: Control the activated build profiles for source builds.

option.name: --compile
tip: Compile source packages after downloading them.

option.name: --diff-only
tip: Download only the diff file of a source archive.

option.name: --dsc-only
tip: Download only the dsc file of a source archive.

option.name: --host-architecture
tip: Control the architecture packages are built for.

option.name: --tar-only
tip: Download only the tar file of a source archive.

next.name: update
tip: Update list of available packages.

option.name: --allow-insecure-repositories
tip: Allow acquiring unverifiable data from configured sources.

option.name: --allow-releaseinfo-change
tip: Allow continuing to download from a repository whose release info changed.

next.name: upgrade
tip: Upgrade the system by installing/upgrading packages.
Never removes installed packages.

option.name: --with-new-pkgs
tip: Allow installing new packages to satisfy dependencies.
Never removes packages, only adds new ones.

option.name: --version
tip: Show the program version.

global_option.name: --allow-change-held-packages
tip: Continue without prompting when changing held packages.

global_option.name: --allow-downgrades
tip: Continue without prompting when doing downgrades.

global_option.name: --allow-remove-essential
tip: Continue without prompting when removing essential packages.

global_option.name: --allow-unauthenticated
tip: Ignore packages that cannot be authenticated without prompting.

global_option.name: --assume-no
tip: Automatically answer no to all prompts.

global_option.name: --assume-yes
tip: Automatically answer yes to prompts.
Run non-interactively.

global_option.name: --auto-remove
tip: Remove unused dependency packages, like running autoremove.

global_option.name: --config-file
tip: Specify a configuration file to use.

global_option.name: --default-release
tip: Set the default release for version selection.
Creates a default pin at priority 990.

global_option.name: --download-only
tip: Download package files without unpacking or installing them.

global_option.name: --fix-broken
tip: Attempt to correct a system with broken dependencies.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Show a short usage summary.

global_option.name: --ignore-hold
tip: Ignore package holds placed on a package.

global_option.name: --ignore-missing
tip: Ignore missing packages, holding back packages that cannot be retrieved.

global_option.name: --install-suggests
tip: Consider suggested packages as dependencies for installing.

global_option.name: --just-print
tip: Perform a simulation without changing the system.

global_option.name: --mark-auto
tip: Mark freshly installed packages as automatically installed.

global_option.name: --no-download
tip: Disable downloading of packages.
Best used with --ignore-missing to use only downloaded .debs.

global_option.name: --no-install-recommends
tip: Do not consider recommended packages as dependencies for installing.

global_option.name: --no-remove
tip: Abort immediately without prompting if any packages are to be removed.

global_option.name: --no-show-upgraded
tip: Do not show a list of all packages to be upgraded.

global_option.name: --no-upgrade
tip: Prevent packages on the command line from being upgraded.

global_option.name: --only-source
tip: Accept source package names only, skipping binary table lookup.

global_option.name: --only-upgrade
tip: Install upgrades for already installed packages only.
Ignore requests to install new packages.

global_option.name: --option
tip: Set an arbitrary configuration option.
Syntax: -o Foo::Bar=bar. Can be used multiple times.

global_option.name: --print-uris
tip: Print file URIs for fetching instead of fetching them.

global_option.name: --purge
tip: Use purge instead of remove for anything that would be removed.

global_option.name: --quiet
tip: Produce output suitable for logging, omitting progress indicators.

global_option.name: --reinstall
tip: Reinstall packages already installed at the newest version.

global_option.name: --show-progress
tip: Show user friendly progress information in the terminal.

global_option.name: --trivial-only
tip: Only perform trivial operations, answering no to prompts.

global_option.name: --update
tip: Run the update command before the specified command.

global_option.name: --verbose-versions
tip: Show full versions for upgraded and installed packages.

global_option.name: --with-source
tip: Add the given file as a source for metadata.
Can be repeated.
